selection_rules.relay: From complete E84 candidates: authored verb=give; goal item owned by paired helper; goal recipient distinct from NPC and helper; deduplicate by authored NPC quest file, retain all partner/candidate IDs. Read corresponding stored E84 native witnesses without replay.
selection_rules.container: From complete E84 candidates: authored verb=put; container owned by paired helper. Deduplicate NPC quest file; item==container kept as unsupported, not repaired.
selection_rules.minecraft: All 12 entries of original 2_agent_hells_kitchen_full.json unchanged; no selection by model outcome.

exposure_scope: A source inventory and design support count, not unseen-world N. Comparison with all prior model exposure has not been completed; E84 overlap alone does not prove other worlds are unseen.
